CVE-2026-116790.title: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digit ...

CVE-2026-49842.description: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to a software implementation that runs on any commodity hardware. CVE-2026-49843.title: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digit ...
CVE-2026-49843.description: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to a software implementation that runs on any commodity hardware. An unauthenticated network attacker who knows a target session UUID could therefore evict the legitimate client. This issue has been patched in version 1.11.1.

CVE-2026-49847.title: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digit ...
CVE-2026-49847.description: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to a software implementation that runs on any commodity hardware. This issue has been patched in version 1.11.1.

CVE-2026-49848.title: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digit ...

CVE-2026-116790.title: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digit ...
CVE-2026-116790.description: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to a software implementation that runs on any commodity hardware. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.2.

This issue is fixed in version 1.11.2.
